bugs.summary: Title and subtitle are styled with only the border style (partial_border_style) instead of the combined panel style plus border style, so the panel's background style is not applied to the title or subtitle text.
bugs.trigger: Panel('x', title='T', style='on blue'): the title and subtitle lose the blue background (Textualize/rich#3569; fix 30e5ed61 reverts to border_style).
